The five days, decoded

Shashthi
17
Bodhon — the Goddess is unveiled. Pandals light up; first round of rolls.
Saptami
18
Nabapatrika snan. Full streets, full plates — start the Biryani Circuit.
Ashtami
19
Pushpanjali, Kumari Puja, Sandhi Puja. Bhog day. Peak crowds, peak joy.
Navami
20
Homa and maha aarti; dhunuchi dance-offs. Non-veg is back on the plate.
Dashami
21
Sindoor khela & bhashan. Bid adieu with mishti and Bijoya greetings.
